description: This file defines API routes related to video detection jobs, including starting a detection job, checking job status, and WebSocket streaming for progress updates. It utilizes FastAPI for defining REST endpoints and WebSocket connections, and interacts with a VideoService for processing.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI routing object used to define API endpoints.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: WebSocket object for handling websocket connections.

methods.name: video_detect( file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file to process"), model_name: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Optional detection model name"), confidence: float = Form(0.5, description="Minimum confidence threshold [0-1]"), )
methods.description: Starts a video detection job, uploading the file and returning a job ID.

methods.name: video_status(job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a video detection job by job ID.

methods.name: video_progress_ws(websocket: WebSocket, job_id: str)
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint streaming progress updates for a video detection job.
